nodes.label: KFV Freising Emblem SVG
nodes.description: Highly detailed vector emblem (1109x872 viewBox, ~6700 paths, 1.9 MB) for Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising (KFV Freising). Heraldic shield form with dimensional rendering. Primary colors: fire red (rgb(248,12,39)), near-black outlines, cream/white interior fills, Bavarian blue (rgb(48,56,133)/rgb(60,83,160)), and yellow/gold accents (rgb(250,233,34)). Contains figurative elements consistent with a German fire-department district emblem: stylised fire-department insignia, Bavarian heraldic colors (blue/white), shield silhouette, and decorative border. No embedded text elements detected.

nodes.description: Dominant red color rgb(248,12,39) used throughout the emblem body, representing fire department identity.

nodes.description: Yellow/gold elements rgb(250,233,34) in lower region of emblem, likely flames or decorative ornamental motifs typical of German fire-department emblems.
